verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a security and compliance SaaS that handles customer data and ships AI features (Fieldwork AI agents, MCP access), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented commitment, setting, or contractual control that prevents customer data from being used to train AI models. Role-scoped assistant access and service-key scopes are adjacent access controls, not training opt-outs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
